opening: I've got cramps in my belly.
It all started suddenly 2 hours ago.
About an hour before this started, I ate some reheated food from the afternoon.

opening.text: I've got cramps in my belly, and it all started suddenly 2 hours ago. I feel nauseous, and I've been vomiting. I've had diarrhea, too. About an hour before this started, I ate some reheated food from the afternoon.
